more_info.overview: Hydroxypropyl distarch glycerine is a historical modified-starch designation combining hydroxypropyl modification with a glycerol-related starch identity. Hydroxypropylated starch and phosphate-crosslinked starch have separate specified treatments in the JECFA document. That document does not establish a complete current manufacturing specification for this legacy designation. A typical current food example and preparation-specific intake basis were not confirmed, so another modified starch's assessment is not assigned to it.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
